title: 694. Cut Off Trees for Golf Event

examples.explanation: Visit heights 2,3,4,5,6,7 in order; the shortest walk uses 6 steps.
The middle wall disconnects the lower trees, so the tour is impossible.
Start on height 2, then walk to 3,4,5,6,7,8 with 6 moves.

hints: Collect every cell above 1 and sort those trees by height; that is the visiting order.
Between consecutive targets run breadth-first search avoiding 0 cells.
Adaptation note: forest grids use int_array_2d where 0 blocks, 1 is open ground, and values above 1 are tree heights to cut in ascending order.
